name: puppet-master
description: Coordinate your Claude sessions from one session: hand each job to an open session or a background worker.

puppet_logs_dir.title: puppet-master logs folder
puppet_logs_dir.description: Where the puppet-master analyst keeps its daily findings, reports and your decisions. Leave empty to use the plugin's data folder.

self_compact.title: Let the master compact this session
self_compact.description: ask (default): an interactive window asks once at start, and does nothing unless you say yes. on: the master may compact this session when it asks. off: never, and the master's own opt-in is ignored. A session the master clears is always a worker it adopted.
